history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1843 in England and came to Chicago about 1853. He works as a commission merchant, and the household lives in the blocks about State and Madison streets. The family's church is St. James's.
